posting.title: Unpaid Marketing Intern (Junior)
posting.description:
About the role:
BrightSpark Retail is looking for an enthusiastic junior intern to join our social media team for an unpaid three-month internship, with the possibility of a paid position afterwards for the right candidate.

Responsibilities:
You will help schedule Instagram and TikTok posts, reply to customer comments, and assist with basic photo editing for our online store.

Requirements:
No prior experience is required — this is an entry-level, junior position aimed at students or recent school leavers who want to learn the basics of social media marketing. A genuine interest in retail and fashion is more important than a CV.

What we offer:
A fun, informal office environment, free lunch on Fridays, and a certificate of completion at the end of the internship. This role is unpaid but travel expenses are reimbursed.
